info.title: Overpass API (OpenStreetMap)
info.description: Read-only queries over OpenStreetMap. The Kumi Systems instance — keyless, faster and more tolerant of small bursts than the main one; still be polite: tight radii, long caches, one call a second.

get.description: `elements[]` carries OSM nodes/ways; nodes have `lat`/`lon`, ways queried with `out center` have `center.lat`/`center.lon`; names and attributes live under `tags`.
